title: You get an MFA prompt at the gate
scenario: Right after an airline-support chat, your phone receives a login approval prompt for your airline account. The support agent says, “That’s me—tap Approve so I can fix your booking.”

answers.A: Approve once because the timing matches the support conversation, then change your password after the booking is fixed.
answers.B: Deny the prompt, end the chat, and reopen support through the airline app or site you navigate to yourself.
answers.C: Ask the agent to stop the login attempt and explain why account access is necessary before continuing.

explanation: MFA approval authorizes a login; a support conversation does not make an unexpected login safe.
proTip: MFA is a doorbell. Do not buzz in someone because they claim to be maintenance.
